SELECT AVG(m.home_team_goal) AS avg_home_team_goal FROM Match AS m JOIN Country AS c ON m.country_id = c.id WHERE c.name = 'Poland' AND m.season = '2010/2011' LIMIT 10000

SELECT year, MAX(round) AS num_races FROM races GROUP BY year ORDER BY num_races DESC LIMIT 1

WITH driver_wins AS (SELECT d.driverId, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS full_name, d.nationality, SUM(CASE WHEN r.position = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_wins, MAX(r.points) AS max_points FROM drivers AS d JOIN results AS r ON d.driverId = r.driverId GROUP BY d.driverId, d.forename, d.surname, d.nationality) SELECT full_name, nationality, total_wins, max_points FROM driver_wins ORDER BY total_wins DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT AVG(r.points) AS avg_points FROM results AS r JOIN drivers AS d ON r.driverId = d.driverId JOIN races AS ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId WHERE d.forename = 'Eddie' AND d.surname = 'Irvine' AND ra.year = 2000 LIMIT 10000

SELECT r.name, r.year, c.location, MAX(res.laps) AS max_laps FROM results AS res JOIN races AS r ON res.raceId = r.raceId JOIN circuits AS c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId GROUP BY res.raceId ORDER BY max_laps DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN c.country = 'Germany' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage FROM races AS r JOIN circuits AS c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId WHERE r.name = 'European Grand Prix' LIMIT 10000
SELECT name, lat FROM circuits WHERE name IN ('Silverstone Circuit', 'Hockenheimring', 'Hungaroring') ORDER BY lat DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT nationality FROM drivers ORDER BY dob ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT r.raceId, r.year, r.round, r.name, r.date, r.time, r.url FROM races AS r JOIN circuits AS c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId WHERE c.circuitRef = 'silverstone' LIMIT 10000

SELECT r.fastestLapTime FROM results AS r JOIN drivers AS d ON r.driverId = d.driverId JOIN races AS ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId WHERE d.forename = 'Lewis' AND d.surname = 'Hamilton' AND ra.year = 2008 AND ra.name = 'Australian Grand Prix' LIMIT 10000

SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS champion, d.url FROM results AS r JOIN drivers AS d ON r.driverId = d.driverId JOIN races AS ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId WHERE ra.year = 2008 AND ra.name = 'Australian Grand Prix' AND r.time LIKE '__:__:__.___' LIMIT 10000
SELECT MAX(cs.points) AS max_points FROM constructorStandings AS cs JOIN constructors AS c ON cs.constructorId = c.constructorId WHERE c.nationality = 'British' LIMIT 10000
SELECT c.name, SUM(cr.points) AS total_points FROM constructorResults AS cr JOIN constructors AS c ON cr.constructorId = c.constructorId GROUP BY c.constructorId ORDER BY total_points DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT DISTINCT c.name FROM constructors AS c JOIN constructorStandings AS cs ON c.constructorId = cs.constructorId WHERE cs.position = 1 LIMIT 10000
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.constructorId) FROM constructors AS c JOIN results AS r ON c.constructorId = r.constructorId WHERE c.nationality = 'French' AND r.laps > 50 LIMIT 10000

WITH german_drivers AS (SELECT d.driverId, d.forename, d.surname, d.dob FROM drivers AS d WHERE d.nationality = 'German' AND CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', d.dob) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1980 AND 1990), earliest_laps AS (SELECT gd.driverId, gd.forename, gd.surname, gd.dob, MIN(lt.milliseconds) AS min_lap_ms FROM german_drivers AS gd JOIN lapTimes AS lt ON gd.driverId = lt.driverId GROUP BY gd.driverId, gd.forename, gd.surname, gd.dob) SELECT forename, surname, dob, min_lap_ms FROM earliest_laps ORDER BY min_lap_ms ASC LIMIT 3
SELECT driverRef FROM drivers WHERE nationality = 'German' ORDER BY dob ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT d.driverId, d.code FROM drivers AS d JOIN results AS r ON d.driverId = r.driverId WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', d.dob) = '1971' AND NOT r.fastestLapTime IS NULL AND r.fastestLapTime <> '' LIMIT 10000

SELECT d.forename, d.surname, d.dob, MAX(lt.time) AS latest_lap_time FROM drivers AS d JOIN lapTimes AS lt ON d.driverId = lt.driverId WHERE d.nationality = 'Spanish' AND CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', d.dob) AS INTEGER) < 1982 GROUP BY d.driverId, d.forename, d.surname, d.dob ORDER BY latest_lap_time DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT circuits.name, circuits.location, circuits.lat, circuits.lng, COUNT(*) AS times_held FROM circuits JOIN races ON circuits.circuitId = races.circuitId WHERE circuits.country = 'Austria' GROUP BY circuits.circuitId, circuits.name, circuits.location, circuits.lat, circuits.lng LIMIT 10000

SELECT AVG(CAST(SUBSTRING(fastestLapTime, 1, INSTR(fastestLapTime, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60 + CAST(SUBSTRING(fastestLapTime, INSTR(fastestLapTime, ':') + 1) AS REAL)) AS avg_fastest_lap_seconds FROM results WHERE raceId = (SELECT raceId FROM races WHERE year = 2006 AND name = 'United States Grand Prix') AND rank < 11 LIMIT 10000
SELECT nationality, COUNT(*) AS driver_count FROM drivers GROUP BY nationality ORDER BY driver_count DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT wins FROM driverStandings WHERE position = 91 LIMIT 1
SELECT c.location || ', ' || c.country AS full_location FROM races AS r JOIN circuits AS c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId ORDER BY r.date DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT d.forename, d.surname FROM qualifying AS q JOIN races AS r ON q.raceId = r.raceId JOIN circuits AS c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId JOIN drivers AS d ON q.driverId = d.driverId WHERE r.year = 2008 AND c.name = 'Marina Bay Street Circuit' AND q.position = 1 LIMIT 10000

SELECT COUNT(*) AS accident_count FROM results AS r JOIN races AS ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId WHERE ra.name = 'Canadian Grand Prix' AND r.statusId = 3 GROUP BY r.driverId ORDER BY accident_count DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT MAX(CAST(duration AS REAL)) AS longest_pit_stop_duration FROM pitStops LIMIT 10000
SELECT MAX(CAST(ps.duration AS REAL)) AS longest_pit_stop_duration FROM pitStops AS ps JOIN drivers AS d ON ps.driverId = d.driverId WHERE d.forename = 'Lewis' AND d.surname = 'Hamilton' LIMIT 10000

WITH ranked AS (SELECT d.forename, d.surname, lt.time, lt.milliseconds, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY lt.milliseconds ASC) AS rn FROM lapTimes AS lt JOIN drivers AS d ON lt.driverId = d.driverId WHERE NOT lt.milliseconds IS NULL AND lt.milliseconds > 0) SELECT rn, forename, surname, time FROM ranked WHERE rn <= 20 LIMIT 10000

SELECT c.name AS circuit_name, c.location, MIN(lt.milliseconds) AS fastest_lap_ms, lt.time AS lap_time FROM lapTimes AS lt JOIN races AS r ON lt.raceId = r.raceId JOIN circuits AS c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId WHERE c.country = 'Italy' GROUP BY c.circuitId, c.name, c.location LIMIT 10000
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hero_power AS hp JOIN superpower AS sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id WHERE sp.power_name = 'Super Strength' LIMIT 10000

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) FROM superhero AS s JOIN colour AS c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id JOIN hero_power AS hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id JOIN superpower AS sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id WHERE c.colour = 'Blue' AND sp.power_name = 'Agility' LIMIT 10000
SELECT p.publisher_name FROM superhero AS s JOIN publisher AS p ON s.publisher_id = p.id WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Sauron' LIMIT 10000
SELECT AVG(s.height_cm) AS avg_height FROM superhero AS s JOIN publisher AS p ON s.publisher_id = p.id WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' LIMIT 10000
SELECT r.race FROM superhero AS s JOIN race AS r ON s.race_id = r.id WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Copycat' LIMIT 10000

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero AS s JOIN gender AS g ON s.gender_id = g.id JOIN hero_attribute AS ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id JOIN attribute AS a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id WHERE g.gender = 'Female' AND a.attribute_name = 'Strength' AND ha.attribute_value = 100 LIMIT 10000
SELECT s.superhero_name FROM superhero AS s JOIN hero_power AS hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id GROUP BY s.id, s.superhero_name ORDER BY COUNT(hp.power_id) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT AVG(attribute_value) AS avg_attribute_value FROM hero_attribute LIMIT 10000
SELECT s.superhero_name FROM superhero AS s JOIN race AS r ON s.race_id = r.id WHERE r.race = 'Alien' LIMIT 10000
SELECT s.full_name FROM superhero AS s JOIN race AS r ON s.race_id = r.id WHERE r.race = 'Demi-God' AND NOT s.full_name IS NULL LIMIT 5
SELECT ha.attribute_value FROM superhero AS s JOIN hero_attribute AS ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Abomination' LIMIT 10000

SELECT s.full_name FROM superhero AS s JOIN hero_attribute AS ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id JOIN attribute AS a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Strength' ORDER BY ha.attribute_value DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT ec.colour AS eye_colour, hc.colour AS hair_colour, sc.colour AS skin_colour FROM superhero AS s JOIN gender AS g ON s.gender_id = g.id JOIN publisher AS p ON s.publisher_id = p.id JOIN colour AS ec ON s.eye_colour_id = ec.id JOIN colour AS hc ON s.hair_colour_id = hc.id JOIN colour AS sc ON s.skin_colour_id = sc.id WHERE g.gender = 'Female' AND p.publisher_name = 'Dark Horse Comics' LIMIT 10000

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN c.colour = 'Blue' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage FROM superhero AS s JOIN gender AS g ON s.gender_id = g.id JOIN colour AS c ON s.skin_colour_id = c.id WHERE g.gender = 'Female' LIMIT 10000
SELECT s.height_cm FROM superhero AS s JOIN colour AS c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id WHERE c.colour = 'Amber' LIMIT 10000
SELECT s.full_name FROM superhero AS s JOIN race AS r ON s.race_id = r.id WHERE r.race = 'Vampire' LIMIT 10000
SELECT s.superhero_name FROM superhero AS s JOIN alignment AS a ON s.alignment_id = a.id WHERE a.alignment = 'Neutral' LIMIT 10000

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hero_attribute AS ha JOIN attribute AS a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Strength' AND ha.attribute_value = (SELECT MAX(ha2.attribute_value) FROM hero_attribute AS ha2 JOIN attribute AS a2 ON ha2.attribute_id = a2.id WHERE a2.attribute_name = 'Strength') LIMIT 10000
SELECT r.race, a.alignment FROM superhero AS s LEFT JOIN race AS r ON s.race_id = r.id LEFT JOIN alignment AS a ON s.alignment_id = a.id WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Cameron Hicks' LIMIT 10000

SELECT r.race FROM superhero AS s JOIN race AS r ON s.race_id = r.id JOIN hero_attribute AS ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id WHERE ha.attribute_value = (SELECT MAX(attribute_value) FROM hero_attribute) LIMIT 10000
SELECT s.full_name FROM superhero AS s JOIN colour AS c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id WHERE c.colour = 'Blue' LIMIT 5
SELECT DISTINCT c.colour FROM superhero AS s JOIN colour AS c ON s.skin_colour_id = c.id JOIN hero_attribute AS ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id WHERE ha.attribute_value = 100 LIMIT 10000
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero AS s JOIN gender AS g ON s.gender_id = g.id JOIN publisher AS p ON s.publisher_id = p.id WHERE g.gender = 'Female' AND p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' LIMIT 10000

WITH counts AS (SELECT p.publisher_name, COUNT(s.id) AS hero_count FROM superhero AS s JOIN publisher AS p ON s.publisher_id = p.id WHERE p.publisher_name IN ('DC Comics', 'Marvel Comics') GROUP BY p.publisher_name) SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN publisher_name = 'DC Comics' THEN hero_count END) - MAX(CASE WHEN publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN hero_count END) AS difference FROM counts LIMIT 10000
SELECT superhero_name FROM superhero WHERE height_cm = (SELECT MAX(height_cm) FROM superhero) LIMIT 10000
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y', Birthday) > '1930' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(ID) AS percentage FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'F' LIMIT 10000
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS inpatient_percentage FROM Patient WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', Birthday) BETWEEN '1930' AND '1940' LIMIT 10000

SELECT ROUND(1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 2) AS inpatient_to_outpatient_ratio FROM Patient WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE' LIMIT 10000
SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS p JOIN Examination AS e ON p.ID = e.ID WHERE e.Thrombosis = 2 LIMIT 10000
SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS p JOIN Laboratory AS l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE l.ALB < 3.5 LIMIT 10000

SELECT MIN(CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', "First Date") AS INTEGER) - CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS age_at_first_visit FROM Patient WHERE NOT "First Date" IS NULL AND NOT Birthday IS NULL LIMIT 10000

WITH abnormal AS (SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX FROM Patient AS p JOIN Laboratory AS l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE (p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA > 8.0) OR (p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA > 6.5)) SELECT ROUND(1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 2) AS male_to_female_ratio FROM abnormal LIMIT 10000

WITH max_hgb AS (SELECT l.ID, l.HGB, l.Date FROM Laboratory AS l WHERE l.HGB = (SELECT MAX(HGB) FROM Laboratory)) SELECT (CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', e."Examination Date") AS INTEGER) - CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS age_at_examination, e.Diagnosis FROM max_hgb AS mh JOIN Patient AS p ON mh.ID = p.ID JOIN Examination AS e ON e.ID = mh.ID ORDER BY mh.HGB DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT p.SEX FROM Patient AS p JOIN Examination AS e ON p.ID = e.ID JOIN Laboratory AS l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE e.Diagnosis = 'PSS' AND CAST(l.CRP AS REAL) > 2 AND l.CRE = 1 AND l.LDH = 123 LIMIT 10000

SELECT CAST((JULIANDAY(MIN(e."Examination Date")) - JULIANDAY(p."First Date")) AS INTEGER) AS days_until_first_examination FROM Patient AS p JOIN Examination AS e ON p.ID = e.ID WHERE p.ID = 821298 LIMIT 10000

SELECT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T2.UA, CASE WHEN (T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2.UA > 8.0) OR (T1.SEX = 'F' AND T2.UA > 6.5) THEN 'Out of Normal Range' ELSE 'Within Normal Range' END AS UA_Status FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.ID = 57266 LIMIT 10000
SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, (STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', p.Birthday)) AS age FROM Patient AS p JOIN Laboratory AS l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE l.LDH BETWEEN 600 AND 800 LIMIT 10000
SELECT p.ID, l.TP, l.TP - 8.5 AS deviation FROM Patient AS p JOIN Laboratory AS l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE p.SEX = 'F' AND l.TP > 8.5 LIMIT 10000
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) FROM Patient AS p JOIN Laboratory AS l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE p.SEX = 'M' AND l.CRE >= 1.5 LIMIT 10000

SELECT CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) THEN 'True' ELSE 'False' END AS result FROM Laboratory AS l JOIN Patient AS p ON l.ID = p.ID WHERE l.CRE >= 1.5 LIMIT 10000
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) FROM molecule AS m JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '-' AND a.element = 'cl' LIMIT 10000

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) FROM molecule AS m JOIN bond AS b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '+' LIMIT 10000
SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id FROM molecule AS m JOIN bond AS b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id WHERE b.bond_type = '#' AND m.label = '+' LIMIT 10000
SELECT COUNT(*) AS triple_bond_count FROM bond WHERE bond_type = '#' LIMIT 10000
SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id FROM atom WHERE element = 'c' LIMIT 10000
SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2 FROM connected AS c JOIN atom AS a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id JOIN molecule AS m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '-' LIMIT 10000
SELECT DISTINCT m.label FROM molecule AS m WHERE NOT m.molecule_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT a.molecule_id FROM atom AS a WHERE a.element = 'sn') LIMIT 10000

SELECT DISTINCT a2.atom_id, a2.element, a2.molecule_id FROM connected AS c JOIN atom AS a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id JOIN atom AS a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id WHERE a1.molecule_id = 'TR181' LIMIT 10000
SELECT atom_id, atom_id2 FROM connected WHERE bond_id = 'TR000_2_5' LIMIT 10000
SELECT bond_id FROM connected WHERE atom_id2 = (SELECT atom_id2 FROM connected WHERE atom_id = 'TR000_2' LIMIT 1) LIMIT 10000

WITH bond_counts AS (SELECT bond_type, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM bond WHERE molecule_id = 'TR010' GROUP BY bond_type ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 1), carcinogen AS (SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR010') SELECT bc.bond_type, bc.cnt, CASE WHEN c.label = '+' THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS is_carcinogenic FROM bond_counts AS bc, carcinogen AS c LIMIT 10000
SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id FROM molecule AS m JOIN bond AS b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id WHERE b.bond_type = '-' AND m.label = '-' ORDER BY m.molecule_id LIMIT 3
SELECT DISTINCT a.element FROM atom AS a WHERE a.molecule_id = 'TR004' LIMIT 10000
SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id FROM molecule AS m JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id WHERE SUBSTRING(a.atom_id, 7, 2) BETWEEN '21' AND '25' AND m.label = '+' LIMIT 10000
SELECT b.bond_type, b.bond_id FROM bond AS b JOIN connected AS c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id JOIN atom AS a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id WHERE CAST(SUBSTRING(a.atom_id, 7, 2) AS INTEGER) = 45 LIMIT 10000
SELECT a.element FROM atom AS a JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2 WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR144_8_19' LIMIT 10000
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_atoms FROM atom WHERE element IN ('c', 'h') LIMIT 10000
SELECT a.element FROM connected AS c JOIN atom AS a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id OR c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_10_11' LIMIT 10000

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(a.atom_id) AS percentage FROM atom AS a JOIN molecule AS m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '+' LIMIT 10000

SELECT b.bond_id, CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'Carcinogenic' ELSE 'Non-Carcinogenic' END AS carcinogenic_status FROM bond AS b JOIN molecule AS m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE b.bond_type = '#' LIMIT 10000

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'h' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(a.element) AS ratio, m.label FROM atom AS a JOIN molecule AS m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE a.molecule_id = 'TR006' GROUP BY m.label LIMIT 10000
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN bond_type = ' = ' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(bond_id) AS percent FROM bond WHERE molecule_id = 'TR047' LIMIT 10000

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'Carcinogenic' ELSE 'Not Carcinogenic' END AS carcinogenic_status FROM molecule AS m JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR001_1' LIMIT 10000

SELECT COUNT(b.bond_id) AS double_bond_count, m.label, CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS is_carcinogenic FROM molecule AS m LEFT JOIN bond AS b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id AND b.bond_type = '=' WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR006' GROUP BY m.molecule_id, m.label LIMIT 10000
SELECT COUNT(*) AS atom_count FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = 'TR001' LIMIT 10000
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(bond_id) AS percentage FROM bond LIMIT 10000
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) FROM molecule AS m JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '+' AND a.element = 'n' LIMIT 10000
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id) FROM bond WHERE bond_type = '-' AND molecule_id BETWEEN 'TR004' AND 'TR010' LIMIT 10000
